tokens.name: surface-ground
tokens.usage: Page background behind everything. Flour-white in light, warm charcoal in dark.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Cards, step cards, text fields and secondary buttons that sit on surface-ground.

tokens.name: surface-sunken
tokens.usage: Wells, timer track, disabled controls and the schedule summary strip.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text and icons on surface-ground, surface-raised, surface-sunken, tomato-soft, semolina-soft and dough.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text (captions, units, helper copy) on surface-ground, surface-raised and surface-sunken. Never for instructions or amounts.

tokens.name: border
tokens.usage: Decorative hairlines and dividers between rows. Not for control edges.

tokens.name: border-strong
tokens.usage: Edges of interactive controls (chips, fields, secondary buttons, toggle track). 3:1 or better on surface-ground and surface-raised.

tokens.name: tomato
tokens.usage: Primary action fill and selected state. Also red text on surface-ground and surface-raised. Pair fills with on-tomato.

tokens.name: tomato-pressed
tokens.usage: Pressed fill and the key edge under primary buttons.

tokens.name: tomato-soft
tokens.usage: Quiet tint behind a selected row or hint. Text on it is ink.

tokens.name: on-tomato
tokens.usage: Text and icons on tomato and tomato-pressed fills.

tokens.name: basil
tokens.usage: Done and success: check marks, finished timer ring, done markers. Also green text on surface-ground, surface-raised and basil-soft. Always paired with a check icon or the word Done.

tokens.name: basil-soft
tokens.usage: Tint behind success banners and done rows. Text on it is basil or ink.

tokens.name: on-basil
tokens.usage: Text and icons on basil fills.

tokens.name: semolina-soft
tokens.usage: Background of the too-soon banner and other heads-up notes. Text on it is semolina-text or ink.

tokens.name: semolina-text
tokens.usage: Text, icon and border of heads-up notes on semolina-soft.

tokens.name: dough
tokens.usage: Fill of the dough-ball progress motif. Decorative only: no text sits on it, the number beside it carries the meaning.

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus outline, 3px solid with 3px offset. 3:1 or better on surface-ground, surface-raised and surface-sunken.

styles.name: display
styles.usage: App name and the plan headline on the Plan screen.

styles.name: h2
styles.usage: Step titles in step mode and section titles.

styles.name: h3
styles.usage: Card headings and timeline step names.

styles.name: body
styles.usage: Default text. 16px is the floor for anything a cook must read.

styles.name: body-lg
styles.usage: Instruction text in step mode. 18px minimum.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Helper text, units, step counters. Never for instructions or amounts.

styles.name: clock
styles.usage: Clock times on the timeline. Tabular figures.

styles.name: amount
styles.usage: Ingredient grams and ball weights. Tabular figures.

styles.name: timer
styles.usage: Countdown digits. 48px minimum, 56px default. Tabular figures.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-text gap.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Minimum gap between tap targets.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Gap inside chips and rows.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Page gutter and card inner gap.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Card padding and gap between groups.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Gap between page sections.

tokens.name: space-7
tokens.usage: Top of a screen below the header.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Large separation on tablet and desktop.

tokens.name: tap-min
tokens.usage: Smallest allowed height and width of any tappable control.

tokens.name: tap-comfort
tokens.usage: Default height of buttons, chips and fields.

tokens.name: tap-gap
tokens.usage: Smallest space between two tappable controls.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Small marks and tags.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Banner and inline notes.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Buttons, chips, fields, cards.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Toggle, stepper buttons, timer ring, dough balls.

tokens.name: shadow-raised
tokens.usage: Step card and schedule summary.

tokens.name: shadow-key-tomato
tokens.usage: Solid edge under primary buttons. It shrinks to 1px when pressed so the button sinks.

tokens.name: shadow-key-neutral
tokens.usage: Solid edge under secondary buttons and chips.

tokens.name: z-base
tokens.usage: Normal content.

tokens.name: z-sticky
tokens.usage: Sticky header and bottom action bar.

tokens.name: z-banner
tokens.usage: Floating banners.

tokens.name: z-sheet
tokens.usage: Bottom sheets.

tokens.name: z-toast
tokens.usage: Toasts such as Added to calendar.
